newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian Nov CPI index up 17.4 percent y/y.
newsitem.headline: Albanian Nov CPI index up 17.4 percent y/y.

text.p: Albania's Institute of Statistics on Monday reported the following economic indicator:
- Note: The Institute said it had changed the method of calculating bread prices to reflect price in weight instead of price per loaf. Albania liberalized its bread prices in July.

The Institute said it had analysed bread price changes from December 1995 to October 1996 in order to adjust the index. This methodological change explains why the October CPI index has been corrected to 143.87 from 141.53.
